performance.scope: Synchronous complete setup, acquisition, snapshots, archives, comparisons and data-only replays under shared host load

conventions.volume_norms: Physical leafwise L2 pressure and gradient; full broken H1 includes both pressure L2 and gradient L2
conventions.raw_darcy_flux: Minus the one-sided Q2 gradient, distinct from an H(div) reconstruction
conventions.physical_normal_multiplier: Canonical oriented P1 macroface normal Darcy flux, evaluated with executed trace basis and signed geometry transform
conventions.original_residual: Original [A B; B^T 0] system normalized by physical source and weak Dirichlet load; candidate recursive and flat fields checked separately
conventions.basis: Numerical matrices and tables actually executed by each producer and comparison; no fresh tabulation in data-only replay

limits: Finite matched discretization agreement and observed smooth-case rates; no mesh-uniform inf-sup estimate
Current manufactured Cartesian geometry is not a literal historical mesh or published-figure reproduction
Single-cell Pk degree hypotheses do not automatically apply to Q2 on a fine submesh
Normal macroface equilibrium does not establish fine-cell conservation of the raw gradient
Independent assembly shares the attributed solver arithmetic
